evals.input: Write a case study for ACME Co. We improved their CVR from 1.1% to 3.4% and tripled their organic traffic in 6 months. They're a B2B SaaS, they've approved us naming them.
expect: Headline leads with the result, not the service
Snapshot section shows 2–3 key stats prominently
The Situation section describes ACME's world before — specific, not generic
What We Did section explains actions connected to goals, not a task list
Results section leads with numbers then explains their business impact
Includes a quote placeholder with guidance on what makes a strong testimonial

evals.input: The client won't let us use their name. Can we still write a case study?
expect: Confirms yes — anonymized case studies are still valuable
Provides the anonymization formula ('a Series B SaaS company in HR tech')
Notes which details to keep (results, situation, methodology) and which to obscure (company name, specific product details)
